decisions.reason: A low-noise burner is a core component that improves the whole infrared heater range, so the firm is likely to keep it despite gas market uncertainty.
This plaque heater had its own product page, which marks it as an important line, and industrial hall heating products usually stay on the market for many years.
The luminous radiant heater fits the firm's specialist portfolio; the 2022 gas crisis adds pressure but probably not enough to drop it within a year.
Tube heaters are a staple for large halls and remain in demand for retrofits, even with uncertainty about gas prices.
The standard plaque heater serves the price-sensitive segment and had its own page, so it is likely kept, though it may later be replaced by more efficient or hydrogen-ready variants.
